## 📚 Core Modules

### Module 1: Kubernetes Fundamentals
- Pods, Deployments, Services
- ConfigMaps and Secrets
- Persistent Volumes and Claims
- Namespaces and RBAC
- Networking and DNS

### Modules 2-12: Specialized tracks

**Code Examples:**
```yaml
# Kubernetes Deployment
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.14.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80

---
# Kubernetes Service
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 80
    targetPort: 80
  type: LoadBalancer
```
